# Latest in AI

This workflow is reserved for Asurada. Confirm that the active agent is Asurada; if it is not, stop and tell Arohbi to switch to Asurada.

Usage: `/latest-in-ai [slug]`. `$ARGUMENTS` is the optional output filename slug only; take any requested research period from the surrounding request. If no slug is supplied, infer a concise slug from the request topic and append the researched date range, such as `latest-ai-trends-2026-09-18-to-2026-09-24`.

## Workflow

1. Follow the `ai-trend-tracker` skill.
2. Use the previous 7 days unless Arohbi specifies another period. If fewer than five meaningful, verified developments are found, expand to 30 days and state the range.
3. Research all three categories: Models & Research, Tools & Products, and Market & Industry. Prefer primary sources, apply the skill's credibility tiers, and corroborate consequential claims independently.
4. Distinguish when an event happened from when it was reported. Attribute vendor claims, forecasts, and unresolved findings accurately.
5. Return a concise Markdown digest with direct source links and source tier labels. Include the date range and any important coverage gap.
6. Save the digest in `docs/ai-trends/` following `context/artifacts.md`: normalize the slug, never let it choose a path or extension, never overwrite (append `-2`, `-3`, and so on), and report the final path.

If browsing or a source is unavailable, say so and continue only when reliable evidence is sufficient. Do not fill gaps with guesses or unverified rumors.
